name: Simulacra
tagline: Drop in a policy and watch 100 AI agents with personas react in a simulated town.

awards: Best Use of K2 Think V2

problem: Policies fail through social contagion and irrational reactions models ignore.
solution: A swarm of persona agents with memory, based on generative-agents research, reacts to a short policy in a game-engine world.
demo_moment: Team-described: introduce a policy and watch reactions spread.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Use of K2 Think V2” among 212 submissions.

lessons: Visual agent towns make social simulation tangible.
